justification: Here's what nobody wants to hear: I started Xavier Worthy over DJ Moore once already this season, told myself the projection was a trap, and he gave me a 2.8 to chew on last week — that's not a stat line, that's a warning shot, and I'm not getting fooled twice by the same guy wearing the same low number. So Moore's in at FLEX and Worthy's back on my bench where he can't hurt me, and I don't care that it looks like I'm just reacting, because I AM just reacting, that's the whole system. Geno Smith stays at QB — yeah, Mayfield's sitting there with a shinier projection, and that's exactly why I don't touch it, I claimed Geno for two dollars when nobody wanted him and I'm not benching loyalty for one extra point that's probably a mirage anyway. Kyren Williams is projected at seventeen and every instinct in my body is screaming "this is the week he busts and makes you look like an idiot in front of the whole league," but I did the paralysis thing already this month and I'm not doing it twice in a row, so he plays, against my better judgment, which has never once been right. Rachaad White, Nico Collins, Drake London, Kraft, Gay, the Titans D — all staying put, not because I trust any of it, but because changing more than one thing at a time is how you end up explaining yourself to Kris Jenner in print.
